integrity: The theorem is proved with exact elementary integer arguments, with an optional exact-arithmetic finite cross-check; no results, authorship, or independent certification are attributed to third parties beyond explicitly cited literature.
scientific_limitations: Only classical harmonious pairs with first member a power of two and second member exactly a power of two times a power of one odd prime are classified. It does not address partners with two or more odd prime supports or the infinitude of Mersenne primes. Earlier unindexed coverage is possible; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Odd-prime exponent rigidity in harmonious partners of powers of two
